info.title: MES Core API
info.description: Manufacturing Execution System: organisation, work orders, scheduling, confirmations, audit.

schema.title: Response Terminals Api V1 Terminals Get

post.description: End the operator session on a terminal (e.g. someone left it logged in); the device stays enrolled.

schema.title: Response Operators Api V1 Operators Get
Response Plants Api V1 Plants Get
Response Materials Api V1 Materials Get
Response List Schedules Api V1 Schedules Get
Response List For Work Order Api V1 Work Orders  Wo Id  Confirmations Get
Response List Confirmations Api V1 Confirmations Get

get.description:
Work for one line: its machines and the open operations of dispatched orders, in planned order.

On a terminal the line is the terminal's; elsewhere pass `line_id`.
Server-sent events: one `machine` event per state change, comments as heartbeats.

schema.title: Response Wip Api V1 Execution Wip Get
Response Get Locations Api V1 Inventory Locations Get
Response Get Stock Api V1 Inventory Stock Get
Response Get Movements Api V1 Inventory Movements Get

post.description:
Goods receipt without order (501). Materials with an incoming inspection plan go to quality inspection stock
and get an inspection lot; they can't be issued until the usage decision releases them.

get.description: Open component demand of scheduled/dispatched/running orders vs. stock (line-side and stores).

schema.title: Response Shortages Api V1 Inventory Shortages Get
Response List Plans Api V1 Quality Plans Get
Response List Inspection Lots Api V1 Quality Inspection Lots Get
Response List Ncs Api V1 Quality Nonconformances Get

post.description:
Report a defect. From the terminal (operator) it is tied to the running order/operation; replays with the same
`client_event_id` return the original record.
Block all free and in-inspection stock of a lot under a new nonconformance.

The operation's current first-off inspection lot, opened if one is due (null when the material has no
in-process plan for this operation).

schema.title: Response Open Operation Inspection Api V1 Quality Work Orders  Wo Id  Operations  Op Id  Inspection Post

get.description: Find lots, serial numbers and orders by (part of) their number.

schema.title: Response Trace Search Api V1 Trace Search Get

get.description: Trace the production lot a serial number was built in (serial -> order -> component lots).

post.description: Suspect lot: block it and every downstream lot that still has free or in-inspection stock (e-signed).

schema.title: Response Quarantine Affected Api V1 Trace Lots  Lot Id  Quarantine Affected Post
Response Equipment Health Api V1 Maintenance Equipment Get

post.description: Operator: "the machine has a problem". Machine down = run paused, downtime starts, machine unavailable.

schema.title: Response Notifications Api V1 Maintenance Notifications Get
Response Orders Api V1 Maintenance Orders Get

post.description: Technician sign-off (e-signature): the machine is released to production.

schema.title: Response Downtime Api V1 Maintenance Downtime Get
Response Plans Api V1 Maintenance Plans Get

post.description: Run the preventive scheduler now (the worker also runs it periodically).

schema.title: Response Generate Api V1 Maintenance Plans Generate Post
Response Spare Parts Api V1 Maintenance Spare Parts Get
Response List Tickets Api V1 Tickets Get

post.description:
Raise a support ticket. From a terminal the terminal and its line are attached; the severity is suggested from
the impact (the reporter may override it).

get.description:
Support performance for the last `days`: volumes, SLA compliance, MTTA/MTTR per severity, categories,
recurring machines, and who resolved (AI, people, ServiceNow/Jira).

schema.title: Response Ticket Analytics Api V1 Tickets Analytics Get

get.description:
Expected new tickets per day for the next `horizon_days` (with an 80% range), from the last `weeks` weeks:
trend, weekday pattern, severity / category mix, backlog outlook and a backtest on last week.

schema.title: Response Ticket Forecast Api V1 Tickets Forecast Get

get.description:
SLA breaches (targets that fell due in the period and were missed) and exits (tickets resolved, closed or
cancelled in the period, met or missed), per severity and assignee, plus what is at risk now.

schema.title: Response Ticket Sla Report Api V1 Tickets Sla Report Get

get.description: The support engineers tickets can be assigned to, with their open-ticket count.

schema.title: Response Support Team Api V1 Tickets Support Team Get

post.description: Add a support engineer (matched to their ServiceNow user by e-mail, then user name).

put.description: Change a support engineer, or (active=false) take them off the team; their tickets stay assigned.

get.description: Tickets similar to a text (full-text, any word, ranked), or the one with that number.

schema.title: Response Search Tickets Api V1 Tickets Search Get

post.description: Assign an open ticket to a support engineer (ServiceNow "Assigned to"), or unassign it.

Correct title, description, category, impact or the linked machine / order of an open ticket (audited;
ServiceNow and Jira are updated).

schema.title: Response Signatures Api V1 Signatures Get

get.description: Events MES could not process (dead letters): what failed, when, and why. For support diagnosis.

schema.title: Response Event Failures Api V1 Ops Event Failures Get
Response Reset Demo Data Api V1 Admin Reset Demo Data Post

post.description:
Eight weeks of support-ticket history plus open tickets for demos (forecast, SLA reports, assignment). They go
to ServiceNow / Jira like any ticket. Refused when already loaded.

schema.title: Response Load Demo Tickets Api V1 Admin Demo Tickets Post
